performance.verdict: Milestones 65+ days overdue; spend efficiency collapse masks a build failure.

findings.text: 5 of 10 SOW milestones due 2026-07-31 remain undelivered 65+ days later: stack test, CRM migration, GBP triage, Meta CAPI, and landing pages/tracking.
4 further milestones due Aug–Sep 2026 also undelivered: Meta reactivation lanes, Search campaigns, LSA, nurture sequences, and Phase 1 close.
CPL spiked +119% 7d vs prior 7d while spend rose +30.65% — last 3 days (Oct 1–3) averaged 4 leads/day vs 8.7/day the prior 3 (Sep 28–30), confirming deterioration is accelerating, not stabilising.
MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP consumed $599.44 of $746.39 (80%) in 28 days at 875 clicks with declining leads — spend concentration in an awareness-only campaign signals creative or audience fatigue.
GA4 sessions collapsed to 28 on 2026-10-03 from a 28-day average of ~92/day; GBP actions also zero Oct 1–3, suggesting a possible site or tracking disruption — no landing pages milestone is overdue.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 9 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer and Sohib immediately; no paid scale until stack test and tracking are confirmed live.
suggestions.monday_update: Nine SOW milestones spanning Ops, CRM, Meta, Search, and Web are overdue by 35–65 days with no completion events recorded. Paid spend is currently $39.79/day with zero Google activity and a CPL +119% week-over-week. Success is defined as each department head confirming a completion date by 2026-10-07. No budget increases are approved until the pre-launch stack test (due 2026-07-31) is verified end-to-end.

suggestions.text: Hold MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP budget flat; re-check CPL trend on 2026-10-07 before any creative action.
suggestions.monday_update: CPL is up +119% over the last 7 days and the 3-day lead average (Oct 1–3) is 4/day vs 8.7/day the prior 3 days. The awareness campaign holds 80% of 28-day spend ($599.44 of $746.39) with no conversion-optimised alternative live yet. Do not adjust budget until landing pages and tracking milestones (F1) are completed. Re-check on 2026-10-07: if CPL remains above the 28-day baseline of $5.92 with no milestone progress, recommend pausing the campaign.

suggestions.text: Investigate GA4 session drop to 28 on Oct 3 and zero GBP actions Oct 1–3; confirm site is live and tracking intact.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 sessions fell to 28 on 2026-10-03 against a 28-day average of ~92/day, and GBP actions have been zero for three consecutive days. The landing pages and tracking milestone is 65 days overdue, making a misconfiguration the most likely cause. Nacer to confirm site uptime and GA4 tag firing by 2026-10-06.
